description:
Temporal refinement against damped mechanics, a controller and finite-wing lag.

References are closed-form mechanics or independent small linear systems. The
gust reference is a small-disturbance finite-wing model; halving its amplitude
checks the separate nonlinear-model discrepancy. No ASWING adaptive rule or
global accuracy guarantee is inferred from this study.

! Original OpenSwing harmonic verification example. SI input units.
! Fixed root, axial stiffness k=500 N/m, tip mass m=2 kg, damping time .02 s.
! Engine setting is a force in N along +y. Set gravity to zero, alpha=0.
! Tip y response per unit setting: 1 / [500*(1+i*.02*omega)-2*omega^2].
Name
Instrumented spring-mass demonstrator
End
Unit
L 1 m
T 1 s
F 1 N
End
Constant
9.80665 1.225 340.294
End
Reference
2 1 2
End
Ground
1 0 0
End
Weight
1 2 0 2 0 19.6133
End
Engine
1 0 1 2 0 2 0 0 1 0 1 0 -1 0 0
End
Beam 1
Axial spring
t y EA tdeps
0 0 1000 .02
2 2 1000 .02
End

! Default body-aligned pylon-tip pitot, accelerometer and GPS.
Sensor
1 1 0 0 0 .2
2 1 2 .3 2 .2
End

accuracy.norm: Maximum weighted physical vector/scalar discrepancy, including algebraic loads and endpoint rates; rotations use relative SO(3) angles.
